newsitem.title: UK: Renault launches UK TV ads for Megane.
newsitem.headline: Renault launches UK TV ads for Megane.

text.p: Car maker Renault on Thursday unveiled its British television advertising campaign for the launch of its new model the Megane Scenic.
The campaign, created by Publicis SA, focuses on the flexibility of the car and targets families. Details of the advertising budget were not disclosed.
The Megane Scenic is described by Renault as a "Multi Activity Car" and is taller than a normal car, has extra storage space and a removable seat.
The three TV ads for the car have no dialogue, relying instead on body language and verbal "utterings", and are designed to be humorous and light-hearted.

"Advertising is hugely influential in establishing the image of a car so it has to be right first time. You rarely get the opportunity to launch a whole new market sector," Tim Mack, a Renault spokesman, said in a statement.
